title: Flatness over a quasi-finite polynomial base equals Cohen-Macaulayness of the expected local dimension
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies, for a finite type algebra over a field with a quasi-finite map from a polynomial ring, the locus where the local rings are flat over the polynomial ring with the locus where they are Cohen-Macaulay of relative dimension equal to the number of variables (statement lines 33741-33754). The proof uses the dimension inequality for quasi-finite maps to compare the local dimension with the base, and then converts between flatness and the Cohen-Macaulay condition in both directions using the regularity of the polynomial base (proof lines 33756-33786). Keeping both directions through the same dimension comparison is the content. H2.
